title: Dixieland
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey man whats wrong with you
Nothing man, whats wrong with you
I don’t like the looks of you whippersnapper
You best take that back you nincompoop

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 1]
This fight is going crazy, the gamblers draw their guns
The patrons started throwing fist and chairs
The jazz band starts playing like there's no tomorrow
And a dude created a window by throwing a guy through the wall

[Verse 2]
The Bartender says, “thanks enough”
And pulls out a shotgun from the counter
He shoots a few people and some glasses spill
And very soon the easy was on fire

[Verse 3]
The people didn’t leave one so ever
If fact the fire only fueled their rage
They didn’t leave, in fact they doubled down
Man this fight is going crazy

[Verse 4]
As if it couldn’t get any worse
The Band joined the frey and fought well
They even used instruments as a makeshift weapon
Is there anyone who wouldn’t fight

[Verse 5]
A guy leaves the bathroom just to go back in
“Screw that” he says and locks the door
The door crumbles down and the man stands there
Only to see a pile of bodies and broken chairs

[Verse 6]
This event was the worst, its in the history book
“The Barfight of 1923” the worst barfight in history
It took many lives and was so traumatic that barfights were no more
To make sure this would never happen again

[Outro]
So if you ever wondered why you don’t hear of barfights anymore, well this is why
Tell everyone you know so this never happens again
Nobody wants a fight worse than this one.
Nobody
